title: Polish Sausage Casserole
description: A hearty, comforting casserole filled with warm, cheesy goodness and the savory flavor of polish sausages.

ingredients.name: Polish Sausages
ingredients.notes: you can use any type of sausage you like, but polish sausages have a nice snap to them

ingredients.name: Casserole Dish
ingredients.notes: any type of casserole dish will work

ingredients.name: Cheese
ingredients.notes: cheddar or mozzarella work well for this recipe

instructions: Brown the polish sausages in a large skillet over medium-high heat, about 5 minutes per side. Set aside.
In the same skillet, add the olive oil, onion, bell pepper, and mushrooms. Cook until the vegetables are tender, about 5 minutes.
Add the tomato paste to the skillet and cook for 1 minute.
Add the cooked sausages back into the skillet and stir to combine with the vegetables and tomato paste.
Transfer the mixture to a medium-sized casserole dish.
Sprinkle the shredded cheese over the top of the casserole.
Bake in the preheated oven for 25-30 minutes, or until the cheese is melted and bubbly.
Let the casserole rest for 10 minutes before serving.
